The '''''Rage''''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] that was stationed<ref name="Orbit" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> alongside two [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]], ''[[Green/Aura]]'' and ''[[Green/Besh]]'', at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Bavos-II heavy-duty military space platform|Bavos-II military space platform]] [[Station 1B6/Green]], on the edge of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali]] [[Nebula/Legends|Nebula]]. The ''Rage'' had 20 [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|Quad laser cannons]], and, as a ''Lancer''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]],<ref name="Orbit" /> was manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="Manufacturer" /> It measured 250 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long.<ref name="Length" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Rage'' was first mentioned in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', and had the same theme of the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'' as it followed the privateering [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. Players can attack Station 1B6/Green with the ''Far Orbit'' as a part of a Scenerio Hook. If they do, the ''Rage'' will most likely defend the station.<ref name="Orbit" />
